individual-data-points.explanation: Stacked composition chart of median state frequencies across ChIP-seq bins (n=5912 promoters per bin); analogous to a stacked area/pie-style composition plot where overlaying individual multi-category data points is not meaningful.
Each row of the stack is an individual DNA molecule, so individual data points (molecules) are directly displayed rather than only an average.
